Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:179919
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22762 of 2022
Applicant :- Vikas Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Haya Rizvi,Anjali Singh Tomer,Balbir Yadav,Inder Pal Singh Toma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Brahma Kumar Tiwari,A/B0231
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Ms. Sweta Pandey learned Advocate submits that she has filed her power in the office on behalf of
applicant but her name could not be shown in the cause list.

3. Heard Ms. Sweta Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Brahma Kumar Tiwari learned counsel for the informant and Sri Manav Chaurasiya learned AGA, for the State.
4.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.0324 of 2021, under Sections 376, 506, 452, 420 I.P.C. and Section 67-A I.T. Act, Police Station Bhopa, District Muzaffarnagar, during pendency of the trial.

5. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and three others on 30.09.2021 and according to the F.I.R. the marriage of the applicant was settled with the informant and after settlement of the marriage on 08.02.2021 applicant after administering some intoxicating substance committed rape with the informant and also took her obscene photographs and thereafter the marriage of the informant was performed with some other person but

after her marriage applicant Vikas Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109558914/
1 started black-mailing her and he started using the obscene photographs of the informant on his status of the mobile and due to the conduct of the applicant, the obscene photographs of the informant gone viral.
6.

entities.text: Vikas Kumar vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire story narrated by the informant in the F.I.R.
as well as in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. is totally false and baseless and actually after settlement of the marriage some dispute arose between both the family and marriage of the informant could not be solemnized with the applicant and therefore on the basis of false allegation even after her marriage with another person informant lodged F.I.R. of the present case.
She further submits that even if the entire allegations are accepted then also it cannot be said at this stage that informant was not the consenting party.
She further submits that admittedly informant i.e. prosecutrix of the case is a major girl.
7. Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that there is no evidence on record which can show that applicant sent the indecent photographs of the victim.
Further, indecent photographs of the victim could not recovered from his mobile.
She further submits that there is no evidence on record on the basis of which it can be said at this stage that applicant posted the indecent photographs of the victim on social media.

She further submits that the applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail since 5.4.2022, i.e, for almost one and half year.
8.

Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayerfor bail and submit that even after marriage applicant harassed the informant and posted her indecent photographs and during investigation the indecent photographs of the informant taken by the applicant was also recovered but both the counsels could not dispute the fact that the informant i.e.
victim of the case is major girl and applicant is in jail since 05.04.2022, i.e, for almost one and half year and he is not having any previous criminal history.
9.
I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Although, there is allegation of rape and sexual exploitation against the applicant after the settlement of marriage of the applicant with the informant but admittedly informant i.e. victim of the case is a major girl and it appears that after several months the F.I.R. of the present case was lodged.
11. From the record it also reflects that after the alleged sexual exploitation of the applicant marriage of the informant has been performed with some other persons.

12. Further, although, there is allegation that applicant after taking indecent photographs of the victim posted the same on the social media and during investigation her indecent photographs were also recovered but it appears that except the bald allegation that applicant took the photographs and posted the same on social media, there is no other evidence against the applicant on record in this regard and further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail since 5.4.2022, i.e, for almost one and half year.

sentences.text: Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in my view, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant- Vikas Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Jitendra  Vikas Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109558914/
